title: Pressure marking of storage tanks.
officialText:
Storage tanks and water heaters installed for domestic hot water shall have the maximum
allowable working pressure clearly and indelibly stamped in the metal or marked on a plate welded thereto or otherwise
permanently attached. Such markings shall be in an accessible position outside of the tank so as to make inspection or reinsp ection
readily possible.
